## How to verify

- [ ] `devtools::check()` passes locally with no new WARNINGs or NOTEs
- [ ] Tests added or updated under `tests/testthat/`
- [ ] Documentation updated (`devtools::document()`) if `R/*.R` changed
- [ ] `NEWS.md` updated for user-visible changes
